A '''research outpost''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aduba-6]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Unidentified Hutt (Aduba-6)|greedy Hutt]] purposely held up a shipment of supplies to the outpost, but was eventually convinced to release the shipment and send additional supplies free of charge.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|The Perils of Greed}}</ref>
